blocks.text: The Brahmins thought in their hearts: if we die, we die — but how long can we go on like this under terror? (29)
The Satguru then told them that if they wished to be freed, they must carry his message: first make the Guru a Muslim, and only then the whole world will follow. (30–32)
So the Brahmins returned, resolved to speak exactly as the Satguru had instructed them.
